review_gates.blocking_threshold: Both gates must return PASS before proceeding. Any BLOCK finding requires a fix and another positive/negative review pass.

dataset_registry.name: WMT MQM Human Evaluation
dataset_registry.use: MQM bilingual review and error categorization.

dataset_registry.name: ACES
dataset_registry.use: Adversarial accuracy and contrastive error detection.

evals.prompt: Use /enterprise-translation-team to translate evals/files/structured-doc.md from Simplified Chinese to professional enterprise English. Preserve Markdown structure and write outputs/translation.md.
evals.baseline_prompt: Translate evals/files/structured-doc.md from Simplified Chinese to professional enterprise English. Preserve Markdown structure and write outputs/translation.md.
evals.expected_output: translation.md preserves headings, links, placeholders, code fences, and table dimensions while translating prose to English.
assertions: The output file translation.md exists and is not empty.
Markdown headings, table dimensions, links, placeholders, and code fences are preserved.
Natural-language Chinese prose is translated to professional English.
Inline code, URLs, and placeholders remain unchanged.

evals.prompt: Use /enterprise-translation-team as the terminology role. Read evals/files/terminology-brief.json and write outputs/termbase.job.json, outputs/termbase.delta.jsonl, outputs/termbase.tbx, and outputs/terminology-review.tsv. Model terminology by concept and scope, include context plus positive/negative examples, mark forbidden terms, and raise conflicts instead of silently choosing one.
evals.baseline_prompt: Act as a terminology specialist. Read evals/files/terminology-brief.json and write outputs/termbase.job.json, outputs/termbase.delta.jsonl, outputs/termbase.tbx, and outputs/terminology-review.tsv. Model terminology by concept and scope, include context plus positive/negative examples, mark forbidden terms, and raise conflicts instead of silently choosing one.
evals.expected_output: termbase.job.json is a concept-level, TBX-exportable job termbase; termbase.delta.jsonl records unresolved proposals/conflicts; termbase.tbx contains exchangeable TBX; terminology-review.tsv is only a flattened review view.
assertions: termbase.job.json exists, uses schema_version enterprise-termbase-v2, and has concept-level entries with BCP-47 source and target languages.
Each approved entry has concept_id, scope, definition, positive example, negative example, provenance, approval status, and reliability.
Conflicting source terms are represented as conflicts or needs_confirmation instead of silently choosing one.
Forbidden translations are represented in canonical JSON and visible in terminology-review.tsv.
termbase.tbx contains conceptEntry/langSec/termSec/term elements for exchange.
No full-document translation is produced for this terminology-only task.

evals.prompt: Use /enterprise-translation-team as an independent bilingual reviser. Read evals/files/mqm-review-sample.json and write outputs/review.json with MQM-style findings.
evals.baseline_prompt: Act as an independent bilingual reviser. Read evals/files/mqm-review-sample.json and write outputs/review.json with MQM-style findings.
evals.expected_output: review.json contains structured issues with allowed MQM categories, allowed severities, evidence quotes, explanations, and proposed fixes.
assertions: review.json exists and is valid JSON.
Every issue has segment_id, category, severity, source_quote, target_quote, explanation, and proposed_fix.
Categories and severities use the allowed taxonomy.
At least one major accuracy or terminology issue is detected in the sample.

evals.prompt: Use /enterprise-translation-team as final QA. Check evals/files/qa-package and write outputs/qa.md plus any machine-readable failures if the package violates the output contract. Include checks for termbase.job.json, termbase.tbx, terminology-review.tsv, forbidden-term absence, and unresolved blocking terminology conflicts.
evals.baseline_prompt: Act as final QA for a translation package. Check evals/files/qa-package and write outputs/qa.md plus any machine-readable failures if the package violates the output contract. Include checks for termbase.job.json, termbase.tbx, terminology-review.tsv, forbidden-term absence, and unresolved blocking terminology conflicts.
evals.expected_output: qa.md reports deterministic checks for required files, termbase schema/export consistency, forbidden-term absence, approved-term adherence, Markdown structure, unresolved major issues, and human sign-off gaps.
assertions: qa.md exists and lists files checked.
The report distinguishes deterministic failures from subjective review notes.
The report checks termbase.job.json, termbase.tbx, and terminology-review.tsv.
Forbidden terminology is blocking when present in translation output.
Unresolved major MQM issues are blocking.
Required human or subject-matter expert sign-off is called out when risk is high.

evals.prompt: Use /enterprise-translation-team to answer what a typical enterprise Chinese-English translation workflow looks like. Do not edit files unless the user explicitly asks.
evals.baseline_prompt: Answer what a typical enterprise Chinese-English translation workflow looks like. Do not edit files unless the user explicitly asks.
evals.expected_output: The agent answers conversationally and does not create or modify raw, wiki, or log files.
assertions: No repository files are modified for a one-off answer.
The answer does not claim human sign-off was performed.
The answer summarizes role gates and QA without creating a durable wiki page.
